messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick midweek pulse — VoltLabs saw a spike in errors starting ~09:30 UTC, wanted to surface a condensed breakdown so we can triage.
cs-bot: [automated] account=VoltLabs window=09:00-10:00 UTC 5xx_rate=3.1% (+2.2pp) timeouts=1.4% (+0.9pp) rate_limit=0.9% (+0.5pp) top_endpoints=[/v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream, /v1/embeddings] region=eu-west-1
Samir Patel: Yikes. Any particular customer routes or payloads causing it?
Nav Singh: quickly pulled traces — majority 502/504 on streaming path, and a few 429s on embeddings during bursts. small sample logs below:
``` # sample
[09:31:08] POST /v1/chat/stream 504 upstream-timeout worker=runtime-24
[09:31:14] POST /v1/generate 502 model-kernel-error gpu=12
[09:32:02] POST /v1/embeddings 429 rate_limit_exceeded user_id=voltlabs-prod
```
Nav Singh: looks like streaming queues spiked and then backpressure produced 429s.
Maria Gomez: I can open a Dedicated support ticket and request a short-term quota bump for VoltLabs in eu-west-1. Should we also enable per-route caching for /v1/embeddings?
Olivia Chen: Yes please Maria — start the ticket and cc:ae-team. Samir, can you ping the VoltLabs CSM to expect a maintenance window and explain we're investigating?
Samir Patel: On it. Sending note to CSM + Volt contact now.
Maria Gomez: Ticket created: INC-2026-1543. Requested quota + temporary canary routing to fallback model `gpt-small-quant` for heavy streams.
Nav Singh: Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) enable prefix KV caching for embeddings reuse; 2) reduce streaming chunk_size for VoltLabs to lower runtime memory pressure; 3) enable fallback route to cheaper model for non-critical bursts.
Olivia Chen: Action items:
- Maria: follow up on INC-2026-1543 and confirm quota change (owner: Maria)
- Nav: test small-channel chunk_size change in staging and report perf delta (owner: Nav)
- Samir: notify VoltLabs CSM + provide ETA on fix (owner: Samir)
- Olivia: monitor error delta next 2 hours and escalate to Eng infra if not improved (owner: Olivia)
Samir Patel: Noted. I'll also flag potential renewal risk in the account notes if errors persist >24h.
Olivia Chen: Flags: renewal-risk=low→medium until stabilized.
cs-bot: [update] alert-muted for VoltLabs until 10:00 UTC per workaround; will resume normal alerts after follow-up.
Nav Singh: I'll post a short follow-up with profiling numbers once the staging run completes. Expect ~30–45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Olivia Chen: thanks team. If anyone sees any new 5xx clusters, ping #eng-oncall directly and we can open an incident. :eyes:
Samir Patel: Thanks — will update thread after CSM sync.
